checked_arguments.finding: _classify starts end=0, sorts directory entries by local offset, checks offset=end and every earlier local field including L=0 and local compressed size equal to central size before advancing. With identical bytes and the exact sole-extra result, a fixed-header locator using those lengths has the same prefix and stops at the same first positive L. The verified directory count bounds the prefix. It is not a standalone reader.

End offset/count validation precedes traversal; local length fields and compressed sizes are unsigned. Sole local-extra failure excludes every other local comparison and the selected central group. Independent subtraction-form locator bounds conservatively re-establish fixed/name/extra/data spans before slicing. Header or locator mismatch must block.

APPNOTE4.3.7 and4.5.1 support 30-byte fixed headers then declared name/extra lengths and consecutive little-endian ID/size/data records. Section4.6.2 permits advancing by declared data size;4.6.3 warns of ID collisions. Ordered IDs/lengths with duplicates retained and complete-or-null output are a structural projection only. No unknown payload or padding semantics are inferred.

APPNOTE4.3.9.2 permits ZIP64 even for small files;4.5.3 has sentinel/field-layout requirements. Sections4.6.8/9 require version, CRC and encoding interpretation before Unicode authority. ID/length alone establishes none of those conditions. The note correctly preserves current flag/version/name/central-extra restrictions and avoids applying sizes or alternate names.

Whole raw target-bearing bytes are acquired and hashed; prior ZipFile parsing privately decodes directory names and may process ZIP metadata. New local loop skips payload interpretation only.
